workarounds.note: parseTSV leaves headerRowCount unset, so the matrix's head row is declared by hand; every merge goes through mergeCells, which marks the covered cells hiddenBy
1.4.1 names resource types and table continuation strings in English and Spanish only: the Italian Tabella, (segue) and Continua alla pagina seguente are written by hand
the opener's drawing, an image element, reserves no height, so minHeight starts the text on the first grid line 5 mm or more under it
page 28 is the last page of text, so 1.4.1 lifts the page-wide matrix to one line under the text; the copy and the matrix's drawings are sized so that it ends about 10 mm above the bottom margin
the H1 page break is restated in headings.levels[0].breakBefore
col() writes the hex beside each paletteId: 1.4.1 paints header, footer and opener element colours from the hex
design text lineHeight is given as a multiple

a day without a note gets its second line from a word joiner (U+2060), not a no-break space: 1.4.1 sets no line for a table-cell paragraph that holds only U+00A0, so the weeks without notes came out a line shorter
